_doc: Roll reveals and rare-item cutscenes. A cutscene level is picked by how SURPRISING the result is for the player: surprise = log10(odds of the tier) - log10(luck), i.e. log10 of 'one in N' for you. That is a formula over the endless tier ladder, so it works for every generated rarity, and as your luck grows the same rarity stops being special. levels (ascending): minSurprise threshold, seconds (length), camera (zoom amount 0..1), burst (particle count), flashes (screen flashes; never more than maxFlashesPerSecond), banner (themed text). lengthCaps maps the 'Cutscenes' setting (full | short | off) to the levels it still allows. reel: seconds of the slot-machine spin (normal for a manual roll; quick for auto-roll and when a cutscene follows; static for reduced motion). A result that is a first-time Index entry is lifted to at least firstFlourishLevel.
